# `Q-12-5` — Invalid field-display-names Value

> A `field-display-names` entry has a non-string value; that
> entry is dropped.

## What this means

The `field-display-names:` key on a listing lets you rename the
column headers shown in the table or grid view: `date: "Posted"`
turns the default *Date* header into *Posted*. Every value under
this key must be a string — the display name itself. This error
fires when a value is a number, a boolean, a map, or any other
non-string shape.

The offending entry is dropped; other entries continue to apply.

## Why this happens

Common causes:

- **A bare number or boolean** that was supposed to be quoted
  (`date: 2024` instead of `date: "2024"`).
- **A nested map** mistakenly used here when the author meant a
  more elaborate column-customization API.

## How to fix

Make sure every value under `field-display-names:` is a string.
If you need both a display name and other column customization,
the other options live under different keys (such as
`field-types:`).

  configuration mistake.
